response_provenance.warning: All matrix numbers and flat-QE band responses are software fixtures, not physical CH/C2/AlO calibration.

calibration_source: fixed externally supplied synthetic engineering configuration; no physical instrument calibration
hardware: root-controlled local RTX4060 Laptop; one GPU job; earlier direct local-GPU authorization persists

oracle_noiseless_gate.interpretation: finite numerical recovery criterion for declared postblur synthetic normal signal

oracle_baseline_subset.rule: all 60 noise cases plus 24 continuous +/-180 e normal cases

fisher_case_rule: same oracle noise inputs: every one of 12 mothers at +180 e and -180 e; exactly 24 linearizations
selection_rule: Among converged alpha grid points, minimize paired-parent mean normal +/- template MSE with color<=20K; choose one best traditional method by same development normal pooled MSE; freeze one configuration before null thresholding.

null_detection.method: higher quantile of independent calibration-frame maximum absolute standardized template; evaluated on disjoint null mothers
null_detection.threshold_scope: simulated nominal calibration only; no instrument or distribution-free guarantee

training.skip_if_no_above_limit_weak_subset: pure physical plus uncertainty remains the candidate; learning cannot create missing information

evaluation_rules.domain: full registered truth evaluation_domain including invalid/rejected estimates
evaluation_rules.normal_amplitude_projection_rule: absolute deviation from unit projection no larger than 1.05 times frozen traditional
evaluation_rules.weak_population_rule: raw-only frozen-threshold detection; sign is external scoring only
evaluation_rules.below_limit_output: template_abstain and low_confidence with approximate signed interval
evaluation_rules.calibration_stress_reporting: separate existing development simulation only; no nominal pooling or real-temperature claim

final_once.final_MC_rule: first three registered signed mothers, both weak signs/noise0; first six registered original-final mothers weak/noise0

strict_stop_conditions: O0 noiseless gate fails: stop ML, inspect solver/forward/optical information
O0 passes but O1/O2 collapse: stop ML, quantify continuum/background identifiability
O3 signed normal not comparable to selected traditional reference: stop ML until physical deployment works
Single bounded neural control fails: terminate neural branch and keep pure physical results
Final test fails: retain failure without retuning
